title.zh: 你现在的文件夹，就是 Wrisp 的文件夹
title.en: Your current folder is already Wrisp's folder

sub.zh: 切过来不需要搬家，也不需要重做一遍整理。
sub.en: Switching doesn't mean moving house, or re-doing your organizing.

1b.zh: Markdown 就是文件真源。现有目录直接指进来就能用——不转格式、不重打标、不动你的目录结构。
1b.en: Markdown is the source of truth. Point Wrisp at your existing folder and start — no format conversion, no re-tagging, no new structure.

2b.zh: 双链、标签、任务列表这些你已经在用的写法继续有效，Obsidian / Logseq 习惯不用改。
2b.en: Backlinks, tags and task lists you already write stay valid, so Obsidian / Logseq habits carry over.

3b.zh: 想要更聪明的召回，本机自动下载对应模型；装了哪些、占多大、走哪一档，设置里都看得见。不装也能先用云端 Key。
3b.en: For sharper recall the matching models download locally; which ones, how big, which tier — all visible in Settings. Skip them and use your own key instead.

dz1.zh: 会议纪要 · 需求评审

dz2.zh: 竞品动态 · 语音转写

dzFoot.zh: 文件仍是你原来的文件；Wrisp 只在其上建可删除、可重建的索引。
dzFoot.en: They're still your files. Wrisp only builds an index on top — one you can delete and rebuild.
